title: Gourmia recalls about 175,951 9-slice digital air fryer ovens
summary: The doors on Gourmia 9-slice digital air fryer ovens can close unexpectedly when bumped, posing a burn hazard, the CPSC says. Gourmia is mailing free repair kits.
body: Gourmia has recalled about 175,951 9-slice digital air fryer ovens, according to a CPSC notice dated November 5, 2026. The CPSC says the oven doors can unexpectedly close when bumped, posing a burn hazard to people reaching in for hot food.
Owners should stop using the ovens and contact Gourmia for a free repair kit by mail. The kit adds a doorstop and installation instructions. Gourmia's recall page is gourmia.com/recall.asp.
Why it matters: countertop ovens and air fryers are popular holiday deal items. If you already own this model, fix it before the busy cooking season.

source.label: CPSC: Gourmia Recalls 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens
